module: Game statistics extension. It keeps named metrics (counters, values, timers) recorded in settings/cloud/gameplay_stat.json, and a separate copy per career profile (career/gameplay_stat.json in the save slot). It measures time spent per mode, level and activity, counts events (spawned vehicles, resets, vehicle switches, finished scenarios) and loads the gameplay/statisticModules modules (watchJturn, watchRollover...) whose workload function is called in turn on the player's vehicle. Modders use it to read, increment or observe metrics.
usage:
gameplay_statistic.metricAdd('mymod/jumps', 1)
local e = gameplay_statistic.metricGet('mymod/jumps')
print(e and e.value)
gameplay_statistic.callbackRegister('mymod/jumps', 10, function(name, old, new) print('10 jumps!') end)
notes: A metric entry is {value=...}; with aggregate = true it also contains last (for metricAdd), count, min, max.

Metric names: paths with "/" (e.g. vehicle/jturn, vehicle/rollover, general/mode/<mode>.time, general/map/<level>.time, scenario/finished). Timers record seconds (real time, or simulated time with useSimTime).
A callback with trigger runs only once (removed after the call) when newentry.value >= trigger. A name containing "*" is treated as a Lua pattern (string.match) in a table of generic callbacks.
A module's workload function is only called if the player vehicle is playable, player-controlled and dtSim ~= 0; one function per frame (round-robin).

Saving: at the latest at the end of the mission, on serialization, on game shutdown or when sendGUIState finds modified entries or more than 60 s without saving; writing goes through a renamed .tmp file.
Minor bug: in startActivity, the level timer stop test reads the key "general/mapmap/<level>.time" (typo) instead of "general/map/...".
checkSaveDecay (not called) assigns a never-declared global saveNextFrame.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded beforehand: ui_imgui and core_gamestate.

metricAdd.desc: Adds value to the metric name (creates it if absent), for general statistics and, if career is active, for career statistics. Triggers the associated callbacks.

aggregate.desc: Also track last, count, min, max.

metricSet.desc: Sets the metric value (general and career). Triggers the callbacks.

metricGet.desc: Returns a copy of a metric's entry.

carreer.desc: true to read career data (if active).

metricGetMatchPattern.desc: Returns copies of all metrics whose name matches a Lua pattern (string.match).

timerStart.desc: Starts a named timer. If a timer with this name is already running, the call is ignored with a warning.

name.desc: Name (also the name of the metric fed).

increment.desc: true (default): adds the time with metricAdd; false: metricSet.

useSimTime.desc: Use simulated time rather than real time (default false).

timerStop.desc: Stops the timer and records the elapsed time in the metric.

returns.desc: Seconds elapsed since the last recording (0 if the timer does not exist).

forceTimerUpdate.desc: Records the elapsed time of all running timers (without stopping them).

callbackRegister.desc: Registers a function called when a metric changes. Callback signature: fn(name, oldEntry, newEntry); newEntry.career indicates the career context. With trigger, called only once when the value reaches the threshold.

trigger.desc: Value threshold; nil = on every change.

callbackRemove.desc: Removes a registered callback (same name, trigger, function and career).

addSchedule.desc: Adds a function to the per-vehicle watch queue. Called fn(vehicleObj, vehicleId, dtSim), one function per frame in round-robin.

removeSchedule.desc: Removes a function from the watch queue.

setDebug.desc: Opens or closes the imgui debug window "gameplay_statistic Debugger" (modules, entries, callbacks).

sendGUIState.desc: Saves if needed then sends the StatisticData event to the UI with {general = entries, career = entries if active}.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: loads the statistics file and the statisticModules submodules.

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game closes: ends the activity and saves.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: saves then returns the state (activity, level, mode, timers) before a Lua reload.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: reloads the file and restores the state after a Lua reload.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called at the start of a level: restarts activity tracking.

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook called after the level loads: starts the activity and reloads the submodules.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a level: ends the activity and saves.

onWorldReadyState.desc: Hook called on world state change; does nothing.

onScenarioLoaded.desc: Hook called when a scenario loads: restarts activity tracking.

onScenarioFinished.desc: Hook called at the end of a scenario: increments scenario/finished.

onScenarioRestarted.desc: Hook called when a scenario restarts: increments scenario/restarted.

onGameStateUpdate.desc: Hook called on game state change: restarts activity tracking (ignored in career while real time is 0).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: accumulates real and simulated times, runs a watch function on the player vehicle, draws the debug window if open.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called when a vehicle spawns; does nothing.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called on vehicle switch: for player 0, stores the vehicle and increments vehicle/switch.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: increments vehicle/reset if it is the player's vehicle.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: forgets the player's vehicle if it is destroyed.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Hook called when the career profile is saved: writes career/gameplay_stat.json in the slot.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook called when career is activated or deactivated: loads or frees the profile statistics.
